method.method_draft: Interpret f(x)+2 geometrically as shifting the graph of f upward by 2 units. From the image, read that the original graph’s signed area over [-1,4] consists of positive regions A and C and negative region B. From the text, use areas 1, 2, and 3 to get the net original signed area 1-2+3=2. The upward shift by 2 adds a rectangle of height 2 over the full base length 4-(-1)=5, whose area is 10. Add this rectangle area to the original signed area: 2+10=12.
